title: FB Financial Corporation Increases Regular Quarterly Dividend by 11%
summary: FB Financial Corporation (NYSE: FBK) announced today that its board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per share, a $0.02 per share increase from the prior quarterly dividend. The dividend is payable on February 24, 2026, to shareholders of record as of February 10, 2026. Christopher T. Holmes, President and Chief Executive Officer, commented, “Our board’s decision to pay our 32 nd consecutive dividend and to increase the dividend this quarter by 11%, reflects FB Financial’s consistent track record of returning value to shareholders. This increased dividend is a direct result of our strong operating performance supported by our growing franchise. We remain committed to delivering long-term value and stable, growing income for our shareholders as we continue to execute on our strategic priorities.” ABOUT FB FINANCIAL CORPORATION FB Financial Corporation (NYSE: FBK) is a financial holding company headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee.
